name: Piedmont Natural Gas
notes: Researched from public piedmontng.com pages only (fetched as plain HTML, no sign-in). Online Services sign-in is by user name and password; registration needs the account number and ZIP code. Residential one-time online payments by bank account or card are free (card online for residential only); Pay as a Guest needs the account number and also accepts card or bank at no charge. Phone payments use Speedpay at 800-752-7504 (vendor fee, amount not published). Automatic Bank Draft drafts a bank account on the bill due date starting with the next bill and can be changed or cancelled any time. Paperless emails can go to up to 10 addresses. Stop Service is online with account number, email, service ZIP and final-bill address; a reconnection fee may apply if service resumes within 12 months. Equal Payment Plan enrollment is online or by phone. No payment-arrangement details were found (family default). MFA not documented.  The Billing & Payment FAQ states a 1% per month late payment charge on balances in arrears (lateFeePercent 1) and that customers who cannot pay in full may agree to a reasonable installment agreement (channel not stated, family default kept). Integrated 2026-10-09: labels.autopay set to "Automatic Bank Draft" now that the template uses the label as a noun ("Turn off Automatic Bank Draft").

help.title: Ways to pay your bill
paragraphs: Residential customers can make a free one-time online payment from a checking or savings account or with Visa, MasterCard, American Express or Discover. Log in to Online Services and choose the Make a Payment tab, or use Pay as a Guest with just your account number.

Phone payments go through Speedpay at 800-752-7504, any time, for same-day posting (a vendor fee may apply). Mail payments with your remittance slip to Piedmont Natural Gas, P.O. Box 1246, Charlotte, NC 28201-1246 and allow 7 to 10 days, or pay at an authorized pay station.

help.title: Automatic Bank Draft
paragraphs: Automatic Bank Draft takes your monthly payment from your bank account on the due date shown on your bill. You need an Online Services account to enroll: sign in with your user name and password and choose Automatic Bank Draft.
Drafting starts with your next bill, so pay the current one as usual; balances already on the account are not drafted. You can change the bank information or cancel at any time.
steps: Complete the enrollment form with your bank account.

help.title: Register for Online Services
paragraphs: Choose Register for Online Services on the sign-in screen. You need your account number from your bill and your ZIP code.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: Paperless Billing emails you a notice with the key details and a link to view the PDF bill in your online profile. Without a profile, the PDF is attached and protected with your ZIP code.
You can send the paperless bill to up to 10 email addresses. Enrolling with Piedmont ends any eBill you receive through your bank.

help.title: Equal Payment Plan
paragraphs: The Equal Payment Plan bills the same estimated amount each month, with a mid-year review and a true-up every 12th month. Residential customers in good standing with 12 months of usage at the address can enroll online or by calling 800-752-7504.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: Choose Stop Service and have your account number, email address, the ZIP code of the service address and the mailing address for your final bill ready.
If you restart service at the same address within 12 months, a reconnection fee may apply.
